column2: ほんとかい！　わしにはさっぱり匂わんがなあ？
column3: Really!? How come I can't smell it?

column2: うう…この醤はもう全部売り物にならん
column3: Sob... none of this sauce can be sold now.

column2: 李坊よ！お前ももういい歳なんだから、そろそろまともな仕事でも探したらどうだ。一日中ぶらぶらと何もせずにいて、みっともないぞ。
column3: Little Li! You're not a kid anymore. Go find yourself an honest job. Loafing around all day doing nothing, what kind of way is that to live?

column2: あんたみたいに豚をさばいて豚肉を売れって？俺はごめんだね…！
column3: What, slaughter pigs and sell pork like you? No way...!

column2: 何てことを言うんだ！？豚をさばくのだって立派な商売だぞ
column3: What kind of talk is that!? Butchering pigs is an honest trade too.

column2: 豚肉だよ～混じりけなしの黒豚の肉だよ！
column3: Pork for sale! Genuine black-pig pork!

column2: 肉まん、野菜まん、チャーシューまん、あんまん、蓮の実あんまん、特大まん、何でもそろってるよ。
column3: Pork buns, vegetable buns, roast pork buns, red bean buns, lotus paste buns, jumbo buns, we've got them all.

column2: お兄さん、おばさんへのお土産にいくつか持って帰らないかい？
column3: Young man, how about taking a few home for your aunt?

column2: いらないよ、うちのおばさんが作る肉まんのほうがあんたの売り物よりうまいんだ
column3: No thanks. The buns my aunt makes are tastier than the ones you sell.

column2: 肉まん、野菜まん、チャーシューまん、あんまん、蓮の実あんまん、特大まん…
column3: Pork buns, vegetable buns, roast pork buns, red bean buns, lotus paste buns, jumbo buns...

column2: あら！李坊、またぶらぶら出歩いてるのかい？宿屋の仕事はないのかい？
column3: Hey! Little Li, out wandering around again? Isn't there any work to do at the inn?

column2: あんたも薬を買いに来たのかい？
column3: Are you here to buy medicine too?

column2: 林の親方は十里坡のふもとの柵を直しに出かけていて、帰りはだいぶ遅くなります
column3: Master Lin went out to mend the fence at the foot of Ten-Mile Slope. He won't be back until very late.

column2: 大工の仕事はとても大変なんですよ
column3: Being a carpenter is really hard work, you know.

column2: ああ～　どうぞ好きに座ってくれ
column3: Ah... please, sit anywhere you like.

column2: ひとつ話があるんだが、聞きたいかい？
column3: I have a story. Would you like to hear it?

column2: おぬし、このわしが十数年前に江南で名を轟かせた名捕吏、人呼んで鉄臂神鷹の皇甫英だと言ったら信じるかね？
column3: Would you believe that I am Huangfu Ying, the famed constable who shook all of Jiangnan over ten years ago, the man they called the Iron-Armed Divine Eagle?

column2: ははは～いい若者だ！やっとわしの話を信じてくれる者が現れたわい
column3: Ha ha! Good lad! At last someone believes what I say.

column2: 若いの～ほらを吹くわけではないが、十二年前、わしは四大悪人のうち、東江虎の游天覇、西淫鼠の司馬無憂、北神偷の銭無通をこの手で捕らえたのじゃ。鉄臂神鷹という称号は、時の皇帝陛下がじきじきに授けてくださったものじゃよ
column3: Young man, I'm not boasting. Twelve years ago I captured three of the Four Great Villains with my own hands: You Tianba, the Tiger of the East River; Sima Wuyou, the Lecher Rat of the West; and Qian Wutong, the Master Thief of the North. The title Iron-Armed Divine Eagle was bestowed on me by the Emperor himself.

column2: はあ…だが…わしは南盗侠の李三思を追っていた時に、生涯最大の過ちを犯してしまった…それでわしは江湖から身を引いたのじゃ
column3: Sigh... but... while hunting Li Sansi, the Bandit Hero of the South, I made the greatest mistake of my life... and it drove me to retire from the martial world for good.

column2: へえ！そんなに大変なことって何なんだ？
column3: Oh! What could have been so serious?

column2: 話すのも恥ずかしいが…わしは南盗侠夫婦に何度も敗れたばかりか、永遠に返せぬ恩まで受けてしまったのじゃ
column3: I'm ashamed to say it... Not only was I beaten several times by the Bandit Hero and his wife, I also came to owe them a debt of gratitude I can never repay.

column2: わしは烈鷹毒爪を極めるため、長いあいだ断腸草の汁に十本の指を浸しておったが、そのせいで毒が五臓六腑にまで回っておるのに気づかなんだ
column3: To master the Raging Eagle Venom Claw, I soaked my ten fingers in Gut-Rend Herb juice for years, never realizing the poison had seeped into my very organs.

column2: わしの命が危うくなったその時、李三思夫婦は過去の恨みを水に流し、はるばる苗疆まで赴いて、苗族のもとから毒龍胆を一つ盗み出し、わしの毒を消してくれた。おかげで…命は拾ったが、身につけた武功はすべて失ってしもうた…
column3: When I lay at death's door, Li Sansi and his wife set aside our old enmity, traveled all the way to the Miao lands, and stole a Dragon Gall from the Miao to cure my poison. I... got my life back, but all my martial arts were lost...

column2: あの夫婦に恩を返そうと思った時には、盗侠夫婦は二人ともすでに亡くなり、幼い息子も行方知れずだと聞かされた
column3: By the time I thought to repay them, I heard that the Bandit Hero and his wife had both died, and their young son had vanished without a trace.

column2: しかも～盗侠夫婦は苗族の聖なる宝を盗んだために呪われ、それで突然死んだのだという話じゃ
column3: What's more, they say the couple was cursed for stealing a sacred treasure of the Miao, and that is why they died so suddenly.

column2: おや…若いの、見れば見るほど～おぬし、南盗侠にどこか似ておるのう！
column3: Hm... young man, the more I look at you, the more I think you bear a certain likeness to the Bandit Hero of the South!

column2: ふふ…そんなはずはないな、気にせんでくれ。たぶんこの老いぼれの目がかすんで見間違えたのじゃろう。
column3: Heh... it couldn't be. Don't mind me. My old eyes must be playing tricks on me.

column2: ちぇっ…それなら仕方ない
column3: Tsk... never mind, then.

column2: ちょっとお尋ねするが…余杭県へはどう行けばよい？
column3: Excuse me... which way is it to Yuhang County?

column2: この方向へまっすぐ行って、十里坡を越えればすぐだよ…
column3: Keep going straight this way. It's just past Ten-Mile Slope...

column2: そうか…ありがとう
column3: I see... thank you.

column2: そうだ…もう一つお尋ねするが、町には泊まれる宿屋はあるか？
column3: Oh... one more question. Is there an inn in town where we can stay?

column2: 一軒だけ、うちがやってる宿があるよ。ただ…もう客が貸し切りにしてて、しばらく他の客は取らないんだ
column3: Just one, and my family runs it. But... a guest has already booked the whole place, so we're not taking anyone else for now.

column2: ちっ…仕方ない、我々は別の手を考えよう
column3: Tsk... all right. We'll think of something else.

column2:
李坊や、志は高く
剣仙まねて雲の上へ
お日様高く昇ってもまだ目覚めず
毎日夢の中でごきげんさん。
column3:
Little Li, his dreams are high,
A sword immortal in the sky!
The sun is up, he's still in bed,
Happy with the dreams in his head.

column2: お前ら三人のガキども、歌なんか作って俺を笑いものにしやがって！
column3: You three brats! How dare you make up a song to mock me!

column2: へへ！これは兄ちゃんが教えてくれたんだ、村じゅうの子供がみんな歌えるよ！
column3: Hee hee! My big brother taught me this. Every kid in the village can sing it!

column2:
呂洞賓、風に乗り
背に龍剣、群がる妖魔を斬る
慈悲の心で苦を救い妙道を伝え
今も万古に名を残す。
韓湘子、玉の簫を吹き
修行を志し家を捨つ
雪は藍関を埋め馬進まず
かつて文公を九天へ導いた。
column3:
Lu Dongbin rides the wind on high,
Dragon sword on his back, the demons die;
With mercy he saves and spreads the Way,
His name is honored to this day.
Han Xiangzi plays his flute of jade,
Left hearth and home for the Way he made;
Snow choked Blue Pass, no horse could climb,
He led Lord Wen to the heavens sublime.

column2:
曹国舅、逍遥を愛し
栄華を恋わず錦の衣を脱ぐ
世に修行ほど良きものなしと
手に雲陽の仙板を打ち鳴らす。
李鉄拐、恐ろしき顔つき
黒い顔に濃い眉、足も引きずる
一心に長生の法を修め
杖を掛け雲に登りふわりと漂う。
column3:
Cao Guojiu loves to wander free,
Shed his brocade robes and luxury;
No path beats the hermit's way, he found,
And his Yunyang clappers gaily sound.
Iron-Crutch Li has a fearsome scowl,
Dark face, thick brows, a limp and a growl;
Devoutly he trained to never die,
Hung up his crutch and drifts through the sky.

column2:
漢鍾離、気性は強く
人情世態の険しさを見抜く
終南山にて妙道を修め
仙人の列に並び道行は高し。
何仙姑、顔かたち麗しく
俗世を厭い静けさを願う
志固く千年百年修行して
ついに仙界へ帰り楽しく逍遥す。
column3:
Han Zhongli, a man headstrong,
Saw through the world and all its wrong;
On Mount Zhongnan he learned the Way,
And ranks high among immortals today.
He Xiangu, so fair of face,
Shunned the world for a quiet place;
A thousand years of toil she bore,
Now roams the heavens evermore.

column2:
藍采和、年は若く
修行を愛して富を退く
名山に修めて真果を成し
棕の籠を手に海の潮を渡る。
張果老、年は高く
髭も髪も白く鬢はまばら
ロバに逆さに乗ってからから笑い
華やかな浮世をあっさり捨てた。
column3:
Lan Caihe, though young in years,
Loved the Way, left wealth without tears;
On sacred peaks true fruit he won,
Basket in hand, the sea tides he runs.
Zhang Guolao, so old and gray,
Beard and temples thinned away;
Backward on his donkey, laughing loud,
He left behind the worldly crowd.

column2: ひひ…はは…
column3: Hee... ha...

column2: 雪蓮子を一つ摘み取った
column3: Picked a Snow Lotus

column2: 空っぽの蓮の実の房…
column3: An empty lotus pod...

column2: わあ…なんて澄んだ泉だ
column3: Wow... what crystal-clear spring water.

column2: 李逍遥は霊池の泉の水を一口飲んだ。疲れが一気に吹き飛び、気力がみなぎってくるのを感じた
column3: Li Xiaoyao took a sip of water from the spirit pool. He felt all his fatigue swept away, and was filled with vigor.

column2: 墓碑に刻まれた文字："恩師霊月の墓"
column3: The tombstone reads: "Tomb of Our Revered Master Lingyue"

column2: おばあ様～わたし…みんな霊児が悪いんです。おばあ様の言うことをちゃんと聞かなかったから…
column3: Granny... I... it's all Ling'er's fault. I didn't listen to you as I should have...

column2: もういい…そんなに悲しむなよ。お前のおばあ様だって、お前がいつまでも沈んだ顔をしてるのは望んでないと思うぜ…
column3: There, now... don't be so sad. I don't think your Granny would want you to keep on grieving like this...

column2: おばあ様～霊児はこれでお別れします。どうか天から見守って、わたしが一日も早くお母様を見つけられますように
column3: Granny... Ling'er bids you farewell. May your spirit in heaven watch over me, so that I may find my mother soon.

column2: 墓碑に刻まれた文字："おばあ様姜氏の墓"
column3: The tombstone reads: "Tomb of Granny Jiang"

column2: どうした、菩薩様は見つかったのか？
column3: Well? Did you find the Bodhisattva?

column2: 頑張れよ！ここに血止めと傷に効く薬がある、持っていけば役に立つかもしれないぞ
column3: Hang in there! I've got a dose of medicine here for stopping bleeding and treating wounds. Take it, it might come in handy.

column2: なあ～やっぱり帰ったほうがいいんじゃないか…仙女だの～仙薬だの、村のおしゃべり婆さんたちのでっち上げかもしれないぞ
column3: You know... maybe we should just go back... All that talk of fairies and miracle medicine might be something the village gossips made up.

column2: いやだ！俺は絶対にあきらめない…
column3: No! I'll never give up...

column2: うわ～お前、行ったきり丸一日一晩だぞ。もう帰ってこないのかと思ったじゃないか！
column3: Whoa, you were gone a whole day and night! I almost thought you weren't coming back!

column2: はは～運のいい奴には福の星がついてるのさ。今回はとんでもない出会いがあったんだぜ！
column3: Ha ha! A lucky man has a lucky star watching over him. I had quite an extraordinary adventure this trip!

column2: おお！　本当に仙女に会ったのか？
column3: Oh! Did you really meet a fairy?

column2: へへ…まあそんなところさ！ただ妖怪ババアにも出くわしたけどな。ともかく霊薬は手に入った、早く帰ろうぜ
column3: Heh heh... you could say that, more or less! I ran into an old witch too, though. Anyway, I've got the miracle medicine, so let's hurry back.

column2: よかった、ちょうどおばあ様は留守です。わたしについて中へ薬を取りに来てください。
column3: Wonderful, Granny happens to be out. Come inside with me and get the medicine.

column2: か…観音様に会いに行くのか？
column3: Are we... going to see Guanyin?

column2: ふふ！違いますよ！薬がほしいなら早くしてください。おばあ様はよその人が大嫌いなんです、帰ってきたらもらえなくなりますよ。
column3: Hee hee! Of course not! If you want the medicine, hurry up. My Granny hates outsiders more than anything. Once she's back, you won't be able to get it.

column2: おば様にこの"紫金丹"を飲ませて、あと数刻ほど眠れば、きっと良くなりますよ
column3: Have your aunt take this "Violet Elixir" and sleep for a few hours, and she will get well.

column2: 仙女のお姉さんのご恩、俺…俺、どうお返ししたらいいのか分からないよ。
column3: Fairy Sister, your great kindness... I... I truly don't know how to repay you.

column2: くすくす…！　本当にわたしを仙女だと思っているんですか？
column3: Hee hee hee...! Do you really think I'm a fairy?

column2: まさか…あなたは…あなたは菩薩様！！
column3: Then... you... you're the Bodhisattva!!

column2: ふふ～そんなわけないでしょう～わたしにだってちゃんと名前があるんです。仙女だの菩薩だのって呼ばないでください
column3: Hee hee, how could I be? I have a name, you know. Stop calling me fairy and Bodhisattva all the time.

column2: じゃあ～お嬢さんのお名前は？
column3: Then... may I ask your name, Miss?

column2: わたしは趙霊児です～あなたは？
column3: My name is Zhao Ling'er. And yours?

column2: 姓は李、名は逍遥です
column3: My family name is Li, given name Xiaoyao.

column2: さっきのあなた、とってもおばかさんでしたよ～　ちょっと術を使っただけで、あんなにあたふたして。ねえ…いくつなんですか？
column3: You were so silly back there! A tiny bit of magic and you were scared out of your wits. Say... how old are you?

column2: 今年で十九だ。
column3: I'm nineteen this year.

column2: わたしより三つも年上なんですね！じゃあ…外にどんな珍しくて楽しいものがあるか、わたしよりよく知っているでしょう？
column3: You're three years older than me! Then... you must know much more about all the new and fun things out there?

column2: あ…それは…
column3: Uh... well...

column2: 聞かせてくださいよ～わたし、もう子供じゃないのに、おばあ様はまだ外へ出るのを許してくれないんです。毎日宮の中で修行ばかりで、退屈で死にそうです。
column3: Tell me, please! I'm not a child anymore, but Granny still won't let me go outside. Training in the palace every day, I'm about to die of boredom.

column2: じゃあ…今度機会があったら、町の縁日に連れてってやるよ
column3: Then... next time there's a chance, I'll take you to see the temple fair in town.

column2: ふふ！約束を破っちゃだめですよ…指切りしましょう！
column3: Hee! No going back on your word... Let's pinky swear!

column2: よし！指切りだ、破ったやつは犬っころだ
column3: Deal! Pinky swear. Whoever breaks it is a puppy dog.

column2: 破っちゃだめですよ…
column3: No going back on it...

column2: 小僧！お前、どうやって入ってきた？
column3: Boy! How did you get in here?

column2: うわ……お…俺…。
column3: Waah... I... I...

column2: おばあ様～　この人を困らせないで。悪い人じゃありません…
column3: Granny... don't be hard on him. He's not a bad person...

column2: なぜ悪人でないと分かる？霊児！何度言い聞かせたことか、よそ者を島に入れてはならんと
column3: How do you know he's not a bad person? Ling'er! How many times have I told you, you must never let outsiders onto the island!

column2: でも～師匠はおっしゃいました、百善は孝を先とすと。この人はおば様のために薬を求めてここへ来たんです、いい人です
column3: But... Master used to say that of all virtues, filial piety comes first. He came here seeking medicine for his aunt. He's a good person.

column2: 外の世の人の心がどれほど険しいか、お前は何も知らん。お前の師匠が生前わしにお前を託したのは、お前をしっかり守ってほしいからじゃ。万一お前の身に何かあったら、わしは亡くなったお前の師匠とお前の両親にどう申し開きすればよいのじゃ？
column3: You know nothing of how treacherous people's hearts are out there. Your Master entrusted you to me while she lived so that I would keep you safe. If anything were to happen to you, how could this old woman ever answer to your late Master and your parents?

column2: で～でも…この人は…
column3: B-but... he...

column2: お婆さん…どうかこの子を責めないでくれ　俺はすぐここを出ていくから
column3: Ma'am... please don't blame her. I'll leave this place right away.

column2: 出ていく？！　水月宮がお前ごときに勝手に出入りできる所だと思うか！
column3: Leave!? Do you think Shuiyue Palace is a place you can come and go as you please!

column2: ふん、生かしてはおけぬ！！
column3: Hmph, I can't let you live!!

column2: うわ～　妖怪……
column3: Waaah! A demon...

column2: おばあ様！　やめて！！
column3: Granny! Don't!!

column2: この小僧は島の迷陣を抜けてここまで入ってこられたのじゃ。ひとたび帰してしまえば、水月宮の在りかがすっかり知れ渡ってしまうではないか！
column3: This boy got through the island's maze and made it all the way here. Once we let him go back, the location of Shuiyue Palace will be completely exposed!

column2: わ…わたしが連れて入ったんです～
column3: I... I was the one who brought him in...

column2: おばあ様～この人は身内の病を治す薬を求めに来たんですよ、見逃してあげてください～
column3: Granny... he came seeking medicine to cure his family's illness. Please let him go...

column2: 二言三言でころりとだまされおって！？
column3: A few sweet words and he's got you fooled!?

column2: お前、どういうわけで承知したのじゃ？
column3: How did you come to agree to this?

column2: だって…この人が…わたしの～
column3: Because... he... took my...

column2: わたしの…だから…だから、わたし…承知したんです～
column3: My... so... so that's why I... I agreed...

column2: この小僧、お前に何をした！？
column3: What did this boy do to you!?

column2: 今日、わたしが霊池で水浴びをしていた時に、この人が…この人が～　それでわたし、承知して…その～
column3: Today, when I was bathing in the spirit pool, he... he... and so I agreed... to...

column2: この不届き者め！！
column3: You scoundrel!!

column2: 小僧！　立て！
column3: Boy! On your feet!

column2: は～はい！
column3: Y-yes, ma'am!

column2: いい度胸をしておるな！わしの大事な霊児を辱めおって？
column3: You've got some nerve! How dare you take advantage of my precious Ling'er?

column2: あれは…まったくの事故…事故なんだ！
column3: That was... purely an accident... an accident!

column2: 道を二つ選ばせてやる！一つは霊児を妻に迎え、永遠に仙霊島を出ぬこと。二つ目は～両手と舌を置いていき、水月宮の秘密を永遠に漏らせぬようにすることじゃ
column3: I'll give you two choices! One: take Ling'er as your wife and never leave Xianling Isle. Two: leave behind both your hands and your tongue, so you can never reveal the secret of Shuiyue Palace.

column2: あの～　三つ目の道はないんですか？
column3: Um... isn't there a third choice?

column2: 今すぐお前を食ってやってもよいぞ！
column3: I could just eat you right now, if you like!

column2: も…もらいます…嫁にもらいます！
column3: I'll marry her... I'll marry her!

column2: なんとかして逃げ出さなきゃ…お前…手を貸してくれないか？
column3: I've got to find a way to escape... Could you... help me?

column2: じゃあ…あなたはまた戻ってきてくれますか？
column3: Then... will you ever come back?

column2: 冗談だろ！？人を食う妖怪ババアと一緒に暮らしたら、命がいくつあっても足りないぜ！
column3: Are you kidding!? Living with a man-eating old demon, I wouldn't last no matter how many lives I had!

column2: あんたみたいな横暴な奴には、ちょっとお灸を据えてやらなきゃな。あんたにも木に吊るされる気分を味わわせてやる！
column3: A bully like you needs to be taught a lesson. Let's see how you like being strung up from a tree!

column2: あんた！！早くあたしを放しなさい！さもないと、帰ったら絶対に父上に言って人をよこして、あんたたちを全員捕まえて、足をへし折ってやるんだから！
column3: You!! Let me go this instant! Or when I get home, I'll have my father send men to round up every one of you and break your legs!

column2: 若様！どうかお嬢様を放してあげてください！私がお嬢様に申し訳ないことをしたのです。お嬢様はただお怒りになっているだけで、本当に私たちを殺そうとなさったわけではありません
column3: Young master! Please let the young mistress go! It was I who wronged her. She was only speaking in anger. She never truly meant to kill us.

column2: 銀花！さっさと縄をほどきなさい！後でこの恥知らずをどう懲らしめてやるか、覚えてなさいよ
column3: Yinhua! Untie me this instant! Just you wait and see how I deal with you later, you wretch!

column2: だめだだめだ！お前たちが本気で一緒になりたいなら、この機に早く行くんだ。遠くへ逃げれば逃げるほどいい！お前たちが遠くまで行ったら、ちゃんとお嬢様を放してやるから
column3: No, no! If you two truly want to be together, take this chance and go. The farther you run, the better! Once you're far away, I'll let your young mistress go.

column2: はい…ありがとうございます、若様
column3: Yes... thank you, young master.

column2: 銀花！早く行こう
column3: Yinhua! Let's hurry!

column2: この恥知らずども！戻ってきなさい！
column3: You shameless pair! Get back here!

column2: 霊児、町へ入ろうぜ！この蘇州の町はすごくにぎやかなんだ、珍しいものを見せてやるよ
column3: Ling'er, let's head into the city! Suzhou is a lively place. I'll show you all the sights.

column2: あの人を一人でここに残しておいて、よくないのではありませんか？
column3: Is it really all right to leave her here all alone?

column2: 今放したら、これまでの苦労が水の泡だろ？あの二人が十分遠くまで逃げたら、戻ってきてこのわがまま令嬢を放してやるさ
column3: If we let her go now, it'll all have been for nothing. Once those two lovebirds have gotten far enough away, we'll come back and free this spoiled little miss.

column2: この小悪党！早く放しなさい！
column3: You little crook! Let me go!

column2: どうした？助けてって叫んでたのはあんたか？怖くなって、許してほしくなったのかい？
column3: What's wrong? Was that you screaming for help? Getting scared and ready to beg for mercy?

column2: だ…誰が怖がるもんですか！適当に叫んだだけよ、あんたに関係ないでしょ？
column3: Wh-who's scared! I was just shouting for no reason. What's it to you?

column2: 自分でそう言ったんだからな。今度こそ本当に知らないぞ…
column3: You said it yourself. This time I'm really leaving you be...

column2: 行きなさいよ。今度会ったら、絶対にただじゃおかないから！
column3: Go on, then. Next time I run into you, I'll make you pay!

column2: 受けて立つぜ！誰が怖がるか！
column3: Any time! Who's afraid of you!

column2: ふん！
column3: Hmph!

column2: 遠くから悲鳴が聞こえてきた
column3: A scream rang out from afar

column2: 助けて……助けてぇ！
column3: Help... Help me!

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん！さっきのお嬢さんが助けを呼んでいます！
column3: Brother Xiaoyao! That young lady from before is calling for help!

column2: ほっとけ！どうせ芝居でもして、俺たちを呼び戻そうとしてるんだ。
column3: Ignore her! Odds are she's putting on an act to trick us into coming back.

column2: でも…わたし、心配です。やっぱり戻って見てみましょう
column3: But... I'm worried. Let's go back and take a look.

column2: 分かったよ！お前がそう言うなら…
column3: All right! Since you say so...

column2: 遠くからまた悲鳴が聞こえてきた
column3: More screams came from afar

column2: きゃあ！！やめて！　"助けて！助けてぇ…"
column3: Aaah!! No, don't! "Help! Help me..."

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん！あの人、本当に何かあったみたいです！
column3: Brother Xiaoyao! I think something really has happened to her!

column2: ちぇっ！またかよ…まったくあのじゃじゃ馬には参るぜ
column3: Tsk! Not again... I've had it with that wild girl.

column2: でも…わたしたち、やりすぎたと思います。やっぱり戻ってあの人を放してあげましょう
column3: But... I think we went too far. Let's go back and set her free.

column2: 分かった！分かったよ！霊児、お前の言うとおりにするさ
column3: All right! All right! Ling'er, dear, we'll do as you say.

column2: やめろ！
column3: Stop right there!

column2: ほら！すぐに引き返してきてよかったです。そうでなければ大変なことになるところでした…
column3: You see! Thank goodness we turned back in time. Otherwise we'd have caused a real disaster...

column2: 本当にすまなかった。お嬢さんをこんな怖い目に遭わせるとは思わなかったんだ。怪我がなくてよかった。家まで送ろうか？
column3: I'm truly sorry. I never thought I'd put you through such a fright, Miss. Thank goodness you're not hurt. Shall I see you home?

column2: しらじらしい真似はやめなさい～　この剣を受けなさい！
column3: Spare me the false concern! Take this!

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん！！
column3: Brother Xiaoyao!!

column2: あ…あんた、なんでよけないのよ！
column3: Y-you... why didn't you dodge!

column2: 俺が無礼を働いて…お嬢さんに失礼をし…お嬢さんの名誉を…傷つけたんだ…あんたの一太刀を受けて…罪を償うのは当然さ
column3: I was rude... I wronged you, Miss... and tarnished your honor... It's only right... that I take your sword to atone for it.

column2: あ…あたし、わざとじゃないのよ…あんたが悪いのよ…あんたがひどすぎるから！だからあたし…あたし…
column3: I... I didn't mean to... It's your fault... you went too far! That's why I... I...

column2: 冗談じゃないぜ…今の一太刀…速いうえにいきなりだ。よけられるわけないだろ…
column3: You've got to be kidding... That thrust... was so fast and sudden. As if I could have dodged it...

column2: ああ！逍遥お兄ちゃん、死なないで！
column3: Ah! Brother Xiaoyao, don't die!

column2: どうしよう…どうしよう？！このままでは逍遥お兄ちゃんが死んでしまう…
column3: What do I do... what do I do?! At this rate Brother Xiaoyao will die...

column2: わたし…賭けてみるしかありません
column3: I... I'll just have to take the gamble.

column2: 霊児は呪文を唱え始めた…~50
column3: Ling'er began to chant...~50

column2: 霊児は真気を使い果たし、気を失った
column3: Having spent too much of her qi, Ling'er fainted.

column2: 何刻が過ぎたのだろうか　"二人はようやく目を覚ました…"
column3: No one knows how many hours passed "before the two finally came to..."

column2: あれ？胸の傷が…なんで痛くないんだ？
column3: Huh? The wound in my chest... why doesn't it hurt anymore?

column2: さっき逍遥お兄ちゃんが気を失ってしまって、わたし、死ぬほど心配しました
column3: You passed out cold just now. I was worried to death.

column2: はは！　俺は運も命も強いんだ。こんなかすり傷じゃ死なないって
column3: Ha ha! I'm blessed with luck and a tough life. A little scratch like this won't kill me.

column2: よく笑っていられますね！さっきの一太刀は心脈を貫いていて、もう少しで命を落とすところだったんですよ。
column3: How can you laugh! That thrust pierced your heart meridian. You very nearly lost your life.

column2: わたし、とっさのことで、師匠に暗記させられた還魂呪を危険を承知で試すしかなかったんです。幸い天のご加護で、運よく効いてくれました。
column3: In desperation, all I could do was risk trying the Soul Recall chant that Master had me memorize. Thank heaven, by sheer luck it worked.

column2: おいおい！まだ習得してない術を無理に使うと、走火入魔になりやすいって聞いたぞ！
column3: Hey! I've heard that forcing a spell you haven't mastered can easily make your qi run wild and destroy you!

column2: ってことは…お前、命がけで俺を助けてくれたのか？
column3: So that means... you risked your life to save me?

column2: わたしが前にちゃんと学ばなかったのがいけないんです。もっと早くこの術を身につけていたら、おばあ様は…おばあ様は死なずに済んだのに。
column3: It's my fault for not studying properly before. If I had mastered this spell sooner, Granny... Granny wouldn't have died.

column2: 今あなたまで死んでしまったら…わたし…わたし、どうすればいいんですか？
column3: If you were to die now too... what... what would I do?

column2: よしよし～もう泣くな。俺はこうして無事だろ？
column3: There, there, don't cry. I'm fine now, aren't I?

column2: 安心しろ…俺、李逍遥は天に誓う。これから先、決してお前を独りぼっちにはしない！
column3: Don't worry... I, Li Xiaoyao, swear to heaven that from this day on I will never leave you alone and forlorn!

column2: ありがとう…逍遥お兄ちゃん
column3: Thank you... Brother Xiaoyao.

column2: 地面の宝剣を拾い上げた
column3: Picked up the fallen sword

column2: 余計なお節介をするから…いい気味よ！
column3: Meddling in other people's business... serves you right!

column2: いてて～押すなよ！
column3: Ow! Quit shoving!

column2: おい～割り込むな！
column3: Hey! No cutting in line!

column2: あんたも婿選びの武術大会に申し込みに来たのかい？参加資格はなかなか厳しいって話だぜ
column3: Are you here to sign up for the marriage tournament too? I hear the entry requirements are pretty strict.

column2: でも～本当に林家の婿殿になれたら、一生栄華と富貴が約束されるってもんだ！
column3: Still, if you really did become the Lin family's son-in-law, you'd be set with wealth and glory for life!

column2: うわ～こんなに並んでちゃ、いつになったら俺の番が来るんだ。もう三刻もここに立ってるんだぞ…はあ…
column3: Whoa, with this many people in line, when will it ever be my turn? I've been standing here for six hours already... sigh...

column2: おい～お前どこから来た、後ろに並べ！
column3: Hey! Where did you come from? Get to the back of the line!

column2: そこの兄さん、ちょっと聞きたいんだが…なんでここにこんなに人が集まってるんだ？
column3: Excuse me, friend, may I ask... why are so many people gathered here?

column2: 知らないのか！婿選びの武術大会の申し込みだよ。林堡主が一人娘のために今回の大会を開くんだ。噂を聞きつけてやって来た若い連中で、林家の屋敷はぎゅうぎゅう詰めさ
column3: You don't know? It's sign-ups for the marriage tournament! Lord Lin is holding it for his only daughter, and the young men who came running at the news have packed the Lin estate full.

column2: そんなに評判なのか！もしかして～その林家のお嬢様ってのは絶世の美女なのか？
column3: It's that big a sensation! Could it be... that the Lin family's daughter is a peerless beauty?

column2: はは…まあまあかな…林家のお嬢様の気性がもう少しましなら、大した美人と言ってもいいんだが、それより林家の財産のほうがずっと魅力的なのさ！
column3: Heh... she's all right... If Miss Lin's temper were a little better, you could call her a great beauty. But the Lin family fortune is the bigger draw!

column2: 林堡主には子供がこの一人娘しかいない。彼女を嫁にもらえば、将来は林家堡の主人ってわけだ…
column3: Lord Lin has only this one daughter. Marry her, and one day you'll be master of Lin Fortress...

column2: ．ごろつき乙
column3: .Thug B

column2: ．ごろつき甲
column3: .Thug A

column2: 占いはいかがかな？
column3: Care to have your fortune told?

column2: ねえ～知ってるかい、聞いた話だけど…今回林家が開くこの婿選びの武術大会もね、きっとまた決着がつかないよ
column3: Hey, did you know? From what I hear... this marriage tournament the Lin family is holding is sure to end without a winner yet again.

column2: どういうことだ？？
column3: How so??

column2: どういうことって！あの林家のお嬢様は幼い頃から家伝の剣と指の二大絶技を受け継いでいて、十三の歳からは蘇州じゅうで彼女に勝てる男の子は一人もいないんだ
column3: How so! Miss Lin inherited her family's twin arts of sword and finger from childhood. Ever since she was thirteen, not one boy in all of Suzhou has been able to beat her.

column2: ましてあの林家のお嬢様は理想が高くてね。この町の若旦那たちで求婚に訪れたのも、十数人は下らないよ
column3: On top of that, Miss Lin has sky-high standards. No fewer than a dozen young gentlemen of this city have called at her door to ask for her hand.

column2: その誰もが、転げるように彼女に叩き出されたのさ
column3: And every last one of them was sent scrambling out the door by her.

column2: 娘さんはね～やっぱり優しいほうがいいよ。少なくとも旦那が見つかりやすいからね
column3: A girl ought to be a bit gentler, I say. At the very least it makes finding a husband easier.

column2: ここ数日、町じゅうが林家の婿選びの武術大会の話で持ちきりだよ…
column3: These past few days the whole neighborhood has been talking about the Lin family's marriage tournament...

column2: 以前、ある人相見がなんと～林家のお嬢様は将来出家して女道士になると言ったそうでね。それを聞いた林堡主はもう大慌てで、あらゆる手を尽くして娘を嫁がせようとしているんだ。でも実のところ～林堡主がこんなに婿探しを急いでも仕方がないよ。林のお嬢様のお眼鏡にかなわなければ、誰にもどうしようもないんだから！
column3: Some time ago a face-reader went and said that Miss Lin would one day leave home to become a Taoist nun. When Lord Lin heard that, he got terribly anxious and has been trying everything to marry his daughter off. But if you ask me, Lord Lin rushing to find a son-in-law won't do any good. If Miss Lin doesn't take a liking to the man, there's nothing anyone can do!

column2: 何かご用？
column3: Can I help you?

column2: 林家のお嬢様はたいしたものね。婿選びの催しを開くたびに、何百何千という人が参加するんだから。
column3: The Lin family's young lady certainly lives in style. Every time they hold one of these husband-choosing events, hundreds upon hundreds of people take part.

column2: そうなのよ！もう五回目よ。あの人、理想が高すぎるんじゃない？
column3: Exactly! This is the fifth time already. Aren't her standards a little too high?

column2: もし私に武芸の心得があって、林家の婿選びの武術大会に参加できたなら、どんなにいいだろう。
column3: If only I knew martial arts and could enter the Lin family's marriage tournament, how wonderful that would be.

column2: 豚肉二斤、刻みネギ四両……
column3: Two catties of pork, four taels of chopped scallions...

column2: 坊や、何をぶつぶつ言っているの？
column3: Little boy, what are you muttering to yourself?

column2: 母ちゃんにお使いを頼まれたんだ。ずっと唱えてないと覚えていられないんだよ……ああっ！お姉ちゃんのせいだ！何を買うのか忘れちゃったじゃないか
column3: My mom sent me out to buy things. I have to keep saying it over and over or I can't remember... Aww! It's all your fault! Now I've forgotten what I'm supposed to buy.

column2: ごめんなさい、本当にごめんなさい！
column3: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!

column2: たしか…たしか…豚肉四両、刻みネギ二斤だったかな？
column3: I think... I think it was... four taels of pork and two catties of chopped scallions?

column2: さあさあ～いらっしゃい～安く売るよ！
column3: Come one, come all! Bargain prices!

column2: さあさあ～いらっしゃい～安く売るよ！
column3: Come one, come all! Bargain prices!

column2: 霊児…この銀かんざし、お前がつけたらきっとよく似合うぞ！　買ってやるよ
column3: Ling'er... this Silver Hairpin would look lovely on you! I'll buy it for you.

column2: でも…とても高そうですよ…
column3: But... it looks awfully expensive...

column2: そんなこと言うなよ！女の子はおしゃれをしなくちゃ
column3: Don't say that! A girl ought to dress herself up.

column2: ご主人！　この銀かんざしをくれ
column3: Shopkeeper! I'll take this Silver Hairpin.

column2: おお～　こちらのお嬢さんがおつけになるんで？若様…お目が高い！
column3: Oh! Is it for this young lady to wear? Sir... you have a fine eye!

column2: 元値は４２０文だけど、４００文にまけとくよ！
column3: It's normally 420 coins, but I'll let you have it for 400!

column2: 近頃この蘇州の町はにぎやかでね。先月林家が繍球投げの婿選びをやったばかりなのに、今度は婿選びの武術大会ときた。林家は本当に金も暇もあるもんだ！前回の繍球投げといえば面白かったよ。林家のお嬢様がなんと繍球に火薬を仕込んで、金持ちの若旦那何人もの眉毛を焼いちまったんだ、まったく…
column3: Suzhou's been a lively place lately. Just last month the Lin family held an embroidered-ball toss to pick a husband, and now it's a marriage tournament. The Lins sure have money and time to spare! That ball toss was a riot, by the way. Miss Lin actually packed the embroidered ball with gunpowder and burned the eyebrows off several rich young gentlemen. Honestly...

column2: あ…こんなこと言うんじゃなかった
column3: Ah... I shouldn't be saying such things.

column2: お二人さん、何かお求めで？
column3: Would you two like to buy something?

column2: お姉ちゃん…おなかがぺこぺこなんだ。お姉ちゃんのもち米餅、分けてくれない？
column3: Big sister... I'm so hungry. Will you share your Rice Cake with me?

column2: いいわ…あげる。本当にそんなにおなかがすいているの？
column3: All right... here you go. Are you really that hungry?

column2: お兄ちゃん…サンザシ飴が食べたいなあ
column3: Big brother... I really want some Candied Haws.

column2: まだ足りないの！？　はいはい…あげるわ
column3: Still not enough!? All right, all right... here.

column2: お兄ちゃん…茶葉卵も食べたいな
column3: Big brother... I want a Tea Egg too.

column2: まだ足りないの！？
column3: Still not enough!?

column2: おなかすいた…
column3: I'm so hungry...

column2: 旦那様、いらっしゃいませ。お泊まり、ご休憩、お食事、ご用の向きはうちの番頭にお申しつけください。
column3: Welcome, sir. Lodging, a rest, a meal, whatever you need, please speak to our shopkeeper.

column2: ほう～お客さんはよその土地からおいでで？さてはお客さんも林家のお嬢様の婿選びの武術大会に参加しにいらしたんでしょう…
column3: Oh, are you from out of town, sir? You must be here to enter Miss Lin's marriage tournament as well...

column2: 違う違う…俺たちはただここを通りかかっただけで、泊まる所を探してるんだ。明日もまた旅を続けなきゃならない
column3: No, no... we're just passing through and looking for a place to spend the night. We have to be on our way again tomorrow.

column2: それは～申し訳ございません…当店の客室はすべて林家がお金を出して貸し切りにしておりまして、よそから婿選びの武術大会に申し込みに来た方々を無料でお泊めしているんです
column3: Well... I'm terribly sorry... The Lin family has paid to reserve every room in this inn, so that those who come from out of town to enter the marriage tournament can stay for free.

column2: ええ！本当に一部屋も空いてないのか？
column3: What! There really isn't a single room?

column2: はい…本当に申し訳ございません。もし申し込みをなさっているなら、話は別ですが
column3: That's right... I truly am sorry. If you had signed up, of course, it would be another matter.

column2: はは～本当に申し訳ございません…
column3: Heh... I truly am sorry...

column2: お泊まりのお客さんは、ほとんど林家堡へ婿選びの武術大会を見に行かれましたよ
column3: Nearly all our guests have gone to Lin Fortress to watch the marriage tournament.

column2: さあさあ、飲め飲め。今回の婿選びの武術大会は、この俺が必ずものにしてみせるぞ！
column3: Come, come, drink up, drink up! This time the marriage tournament is as good as mine!

column2: ほらを吹くなよ。この前あの林家のお嬢様に一蹴りで蹴り落とされたのは誰だったかな？！
column3: Quit bragging. Who was it that got kicked right off the stage by Miss Lin last time?!

column2: まったくだ！大ぼらを吹いて顔色一つ変えないとは、大したもんだよ。
column3: You said it! Blowing all that hot air without even blushing. You're really something.

column2: 蘇州の町はこの時期になると、本当ににぎやかになるな。
column3: Suzhou sure gets lively around this time.

column2: まったくだ！天下各地の武林の達人が一堂に会するのも、林家のお嬢様を手に入れるためじゃないか！
column3: Doesn't it just! Martial masters from all across the land gathered in one place, and all to win Miss Lin!

column2: そうとも限らんぞ…参加者の半分以上は、林家堡の堡主、林天南の武林での勢力を借りて一気にのし上がりたいか、あるいは林家の財産を手に入れたいというのが本音だろう。
column3: I wouldn't be so sure... More than half of those who've come are probably hoping to rise to the top in one leap on the strength of Lin Tiannan, the lord of Lin Fortress, and his influence in the martial world. Either that, or what they're really after is the Lin family fortune.

column2: いつまで待たせるんだ、この俺様が頼んだ酒と料理はまだ来んのか？この俺様が彭門「五虎断門刀」の二番頭、彭覇天だと知らんのか？
column3: What's taking so long? Where are the food and wine I ordered? Don't you know I'm Peng Batian, second-in-command of the Peng clan's 'Five Tigers Door-Breaking Saber'?

column2: うう…鋼の男でも空きっ腹には勝てん
column3: Ugh... even a man of iron can't hold out against an empty belly.

column3: I have long heard of Miss Lin's reputation. I hope to see what she truly looks like with my own eyes tomorrow.

column3: This is my first time entering Lin Fortress's husband-choosing contest as well. I hope to outshine all the other fighters and take first place.

column3: Ohh... what am I going to do? I've gambled away all my money. I can't face my wife and children at home.

column3: Welcome, sir! Come play a few rounds! Haven't you heard the saying, 'A small bet can start a business, a big bet can build a family fortune'?

column2: 兄ちゃん！忠告しておくよ。ことわざにも「十回賭ければ九回負ける」って言うだろ。くれぐれも博打にのめり込むんじゃないよ！
column3: Young fellow! Take my advice. As the saying goes, 'Bet ten times, lose nine.' Whatever you do, don't get hooked on gambling!

column3: Strange. Why is my luck so bad today?

column3: Watch out! I think this gambling den cheats. Otherwise how could I have lost so badly today?

column2: は！は！は！今日は元を取り返したぞ。

column3: I'm finished! I've even lost my coffin money. I'm done for now.

column2: 兄ちゃん、早く！俺と同じ所に賭けな、間違いないから。
column3: Quick, young fellow! Bet the way I bet. You can't go wrong.

column2: ああもう！なんで俺が奇数に賭けると偶数が出て、偶数に賭けると奇数が出るんだ。この賭場はいかさまをしてるんじゃないのか！
column3: Argh! Why is it that when I bet odd it comes up even, and when I bet even it comes up odd? Is this place rigged or what!

column2: 賭けた賭けた賭けた！賭けたら手を離しな、開けるぞ！
column3: Place your bets, place your bets! Bets down, hands off. Here it comes!

column2: 質入れに来たんだろ？無駄話は抜きにして、質に入れたい物を出しな！
column3: Here to pawn something, are you? Let's skip the small talk. Show me what you want to pawn!

column2: 兄ちゃん！明日の林家の婿選びの武術大会に出るつもりかい？早いとこ手になじむ得物を一つ選びな！
column3: Young fellow! Thinking of entering the Lin family's marriage tournament tomorrow? Then hurry and pick yourself a weapon that suits your hand!

column2: いらっしゃいませ、何かお薬をお求めですか？

column2: うう…お兄ちゃんが遊んでくれないよ
column3: Sniff... big brother won't play with me.

column2: はあ……
column3: Sigh...

column2: おじさん～　どうしてそんなにため息をついてるんだ？
column3: Sir... why are you sighing so heavily?

column2: わしの大事な娘の小玉が、先日町の外の川辺へ遊びに出かけたきり、姿を消してしもうたのじゃ。大勢の者に探させておるが、いっこうに見つからん
column3: My precious daughter Xiaoyu went out to the riverbank outside the city some days ago and vanished. I've sent many men to look for her, but they just can't find her.

column2: 妖怪にさらわれるのを見たという者もおる。うう…もしそれが本当なら、わしはもう二度と小玉に会えぬかもしれん…
column3: Someone saw her being carried off by a demon. Ohh... if that's true, I may never see Xiaoyu again...

column2: おじ様、それはまだ分かりませんよ。妖怪がみんな人に害をなすわけではありませんから
column3: Sir, you can't be certain of that. Not all demons do people harm.

column2: もし娘の身に万一のことがあったら、あの子の運が悪かったと思うしかない
column3: If the worst really has befallen my daughter, I can only blame her ill fate.

column2: わしが心配なのは…その妖怪が、生まれつき淫らで邪悪な半人半蛇の妖怪だという噂じゃ。もし…もしものことがあれば…あの子はこの先どうやって世間に顔向けすればよいのじゃ！
column3: What worries me is... they say that demon is a half-human snake demon, lecherous and wicked by nature. If... if he... how could she ever hold her head up again!

column2: そうじゃ…そこのお嬢さん、あんたも気をつけたほうがよい。あの蛇妖がさらっていくのは、みなあんたくらいの年頃の娘ばかりじゃ
column3: Oh yes... young lady, you had best be careful too. The girls that snake demon carries off are all about your age.

column2: うう…わしの娘よ
column3: Ohh... my daughter...

column2: 殴り殺せ！　蹴り殺せ！ヒキガエルの分際で白鳥の肉を食おうなんて、小便に自分の顔でも映してみやがれ！
column3: Beat him to death! Kick him to death! A toad lusting after swan meat! Go take a look at yourself in a puddle of your own piss!

column2: 待った！　みんな、話し合えば分かるだろ
column3: Hold on! Gentlemen, surely we can talk this over.

column2: あいたた…助かった…
column3: Ouch... I'm saved...

column2: 李兄が義によって助けてくださったこと、この劉、感謝に堪えません
column3: Brother Li, you came to my rescue out of a sense of justice. I cannot thank you enough.

column2: たいしたことじゃないって！　それより劉兄がわざわざこんなうまい酒とごちそうを用意してくれて、かえってこっちが恐縮しちまうよ
column3: Oh, it was nothing! If anything, Brother Liu, with you laying out such a fine spread of food and wine, I feel I hardly deserve it.

column2: 李兄、ご遠慮が過ぎますよ！私はあなたと友の交わりを結びたいのですが、李兄のお考えはいかがでしょう？
column3: You're too modest, Brother Li! I would like to be your friend. What do you say?

column2: 四海の内はみな兄弟、断る理由なんてないさ
column3: All men within the four seas are brothers. Why ever not?

column2: よし…乾杯しましょう！
column3: Good... then let us drink!

column2: 趙霊児は酒に弱く、眠ってしまった。李と劉の二人は、知己と飲めば千杯も少なしとばかりに、飲み続け語り続け、そのまま一夜が過ぎた…
column3: Zhao Ling'er, unable to hold her wine, fell asleep. For Li and Liu, a thousand cups were too few between kindred spirits. They went on drinking and talking, and so the night passed...

column2: 李兄…私は大事な用がありますので、お先に失礼します
column3: Brother Li... I have pressing business, so I must take my leave.

column2: また会おうぜ…
column3: Until we meet again...

column2: 李兄、見送りは結構ですよ…
column3: Brother Li, there's no need to see me off...

column2: 鉄口直断…当たらなければお代は無用。お二人さん、占ってみるかね？
column3: Iron-mouth verdicts... no charge if I'm wrong. Would you two like your fortunes told?

column2: 当たらなきゃタダ！？　よし～最近の俺の運勢を占ってくれよ
column3: No charge if you're wrong!? All right, tell me how my luck's been running lately.

column2: 若様は血色に赤みが差し、顔に桃花の相が出ておる。間違いなく女運が巡ってきておるぞ！
column3: Your complexion is flushed, sir, and peach blossoms show in your face. You are surely in for luck in love!

column2: 女は水なり、水は舟を載せもすれば覆しもする。若様、くれぐれも慎重に～お忘れなく～お忘れなく
column3: Woman is water, and water can carry a boat or capsize it. Be most careful, sir. Remember that... remember it well.

column2: へえ！　俺に女運が？
column3: Hey! Me, lucky in love?

column2: こちらのお嬢さんも一つ占ってみるかね？
column3: Would the young lady like a reading as well?

column2: はい……ぜひ！
column3: Oh, yes...!

column2: ふむ…どれ、見てみよう…
column3: Hmm... let me see...

column2: おお！　お嬢さんは瑶光が頭上に集まり、霊気があふれんばかり…この世にまれなお方じゃ。朝廷にあれば必ずや皇后となり、野にあっても人中の傑物となろう
column3: Oh! A radiant light gathers above your head, Miss, and your spiritual aura is overwhelming... rarely seen in this world. At court you would surely be an empress, and even among the common folk you would stand out as a great figure.

column2: だが…眉間に殺気が潜んでおる。おそらく…近いうちに必ず災難があるじゃろう！
column3: But... a baleful air lurks between your brows. I fear... a calamity will surely come upon you soon!

column3: Sir... you haven't paid yet?!

column2: 当たらなきゃタダだって言ったじゃないか？

column2: うーん～　わたし、まだ眠いです…

column3: The sun's shining on your backside! Up, up! Brother Xiaoyao promised to show you around Suzhou. If you keep lying in bed, I won't take you!

column2: ふふ～　わたし、行きます！
column3: Hee hee... I want to go!

column3: It looks like so much fun. I want to go in and watch too.

column3: I wish you a safe journey. This is as far as I can take you. Suzhou is just a short way ahead.

column3: No! No! We're only passing through.

column2: 林家の親父さんがなんで急に婿探しを焦りだしたか知ってるかい？
column3: Do you know why old man Lin is suddenly in such a hurry to find a son-in-law?

column2: 自分ももう歳で、衰えたと感じてるからさ。ところがあいにく、奥さんは林家に娘を一人残しただけだった。だから早く腕の立つ若者を見つけて林家堡を継がせたいんだ。林家の武林での名声が廃れてしまわないようにね
column3: It's because he feels he's gotten old and past his prime. But as luck would have it, his wife left the Lin family just the one daughter. So he wants to quickly find a young man of great martial skill to inherit Lin Fortress, so the family's standing in the martial world won't decline.

column2: 手になじむ武器を選びな。明日、美しい花嫁を勝ち取るためにな
column3: Pick a weapon that feels right in your hand, so you can win yourself a pretty bride tomorrow.

column2: 聞いた話じゃ先月ね…西の村に蛇妖が出て、たくさんの金品を奪ったうえに、張じいさんの孫娘までさらっていったそうだよ
column3: I hear that last month... a snake demon raided the village to the west. Not only did it make off with a lot of valuables, it carried off Old Man Zhang's granddaughter too.

column2: その孫娘はまだ十六でね。かわいそうに張じいさんは七十の高齢で、じいさんと孫の二人、ずっと寄り添って暮らしてきたんだ。張じいさんはすっかり悲しんでしまって、近所の人たちがそろって林家へ押しかけ、林堡主に乗り出してくれるよう頼み込んだ。林堡主は義として断れぬと、十数人の男衆を率いて妖怪退治と人助けに向かったんだが、結局妖怪には出会えず、かえって七、八人の命を失ってしまった。思うにね…林家堡も武林では名ばかりってことさ
column3: That granddaughter is only sixteen. Poor Old Man Zhang is seventy, and the two of them had only each other to depend on. He was heartbroken, so the neighbors all went to the Lin house together and begged Lord Lin to step in. Feeling honor-bound, Lord Lin led a dozen or so able men to slay the demon and rescue the girl. In the end they never even laid eyes on the demon, yet they lost seven or eight lives. If you ask me... Lin Fortress's fame in the martial world is nothing but an empty name.

column2: もっとも林堡主の娘のほうは気が強いので有名でね。若いのに武芸は大したもので、ちっとも女の子らしくないんだ
column3: Lord Lin's daughter, though, is famous for being fierce. Young as she is, her martial arts are formidable. She's nothing like a girl at all.

column2: どうしたらいいの？母さんは重い病気なのに、薬を買うお金もない。これが貧しい家の運命だっていうの？
column3: What am I to do? Mother is gravely ill and I have no money to buy her medicine. Is this truly the fate of the poor?

column2: 逍遥お兄ちゃん～あの子を助けてあげませんか？
column3: Brother Xiaoyao... can't we help her?

column2: お嬢ちゃん、ほら、ここに百文ある。まずはこれを使いな。薬を買ったら急いで家に帰るんだぞ！
column3: Here, little miss. Here's a hundred coins. Take it and use it. Buy the medicine and hurry home!

column2: ありがとうございます、このご恩は決して忘れません。
column3: Thank you, thank you for your great kindness.

column2: はあ…どうしてうちはこんなに貧しいの
column3: Sigh... why does our family have to be so poor?

column2: 俺だってあの子は気の毒だと思うさ。でも俺たちの路銀も多くないんだ、節約しないとな
column3: I feel sorry for her too. But we don't have much travel money ourselves. We have to make it last.

column2: いいにはいいんだが…俺たちも金が足りないんだ
column3: I'd like to... but we don't have enough money ourselves.

column2: 金を貸してくれないか、負けを取り返したいんだ
column3: Lend me some money so I can win back my losses, will you?

column2: ありがとう、勝ったら必ず返すよ
column3: Thanks. I'll pay you back for sure once I win.

column2: あの博打狂いは相手にするな。家の財産を全部すっても懲りずに、人に会うたび金を借りて、まだ取り返そうとしてるんだ
column3: Pay that gambling addict no mind. He's gambled away his whole family fortune and still won't quit. He asks everyone he sees for a loan, still hoping to win it all back.

column2: やれやれ…だまされたね。あの博打狂いはもう何人から金を借りたか分からないが、一度だって返したことはないんだよ
column3: Sigh... you've been had. That gambling addict has borrowed from who knows how many people, and he's never once paid anyone back.

column2: あら、どちら様？うちの主人をお探しですか。今は留守にしてますよ！
column3: Oh, and who might you be? Are you looking for my husband? He's not home right now!

column2: 菩薩様、どうかお守りください。うちの娘がよい家に嫁いで、この先食べる物にも着る物にも困りませんように。そうなれば私はもう思い残すことはありません。
column3: Bodhisattva, bless us. May my daughter marry into a good family and never want for food or clothing. Then I shall be perfectly content.

column2: 人の部屋に勝手に入ってこないでよ！
column3: Don't just barge into someone's room!

column2: わんちゃんと遊んでるの
column3: I'm playing with my doggy.

column2: わんちゃん！　おいで
column3: Doggy! Come here!

column2: あんたたちも一杯やっていきなよ！
column3: Come have a drink with us!

column2: この商談がまとまれば、俺は大もうけだ
column3: If this deal goes through, I'll be rich.

column2: 飯はまだか、ばあさん？腹が減って死にそうだ
column3: Is dinner ready yet, dear? I'm starving.

column2: もうすぐですよ～そこに座ってせかすばっかりで、手伝いもしないんだから。
column3: Almost! All you do is sit there nagging, nagging, nagging, and never lift a finger to help.

column2: サンザシ飴はいかが？
column3: Care for some Candied Haws?

column2: 旦那…一本２０文です。お金が足りませんよ
column3: Sir... it's 20 coins a stick. You don't have enough money.

column2: みんなもう林家堡へ行ってしまったぞ。早く行かないか。
column3: Everyone's already gone to Lin Fortress. You'd better hurry over.

column2: そうだよ！婿選びの武術大会はもう始まってるよ！
column3: That's right! The marriage tournament has already begun!

column2: 蘇州は美人の産地ってみんな言うでしょ。ねえ見て～あたしも美人のうちに入るかしら
column3: Everyone says Suzhou is known for its beauties. Look at me. Would you say I count as one?

column2: ふん～見る目がないのね
column3: Hmph! You have no taste.

column2: さあ、さあ、さあ！見事な芸が見たい人は急いでおいで
column3: Step right up, step right up! Hurry over if you want to see a marvelous show!

column2: 俺たち兄弟は天下各地を渡り歩いてきた。頼りにしてるのは本物の技、確かな腕前だ。皆さん、どうぞごひいきに
column3: We brothers have roamed the whole land, north and south, living by real kung fu and solid skill. Please give us your generous support!

column2: はあ～　ああ～！
column3: Haa... aaah!

column2: うわあ…怖い
column3: Eek... how scary!

column2: 剣を飲み込んで、おなかは痛くないのかね？
column3: Swallowing a sword like that, doesn't his stomach hurt?

column2: 本当に剣をおなかの中まで飲み込んだの？
column3: Did he really swallow the sword all the way into his belly?

column2: 本当みたいだよ
column3: It looks like he really did.

column2: 古い手だ～見飽きたよ！
column3: That old trick! I've seen it a hundred times!

column2: この二人、なかなか見事な腕前だ。一日にいくら稼げるんだろうな
column3: These two put on a pretty good show. I wonder how much they make in a day.

column2: わあ…すごいや！
column3: Wow... amazing!

column2: あれ、劉兄じゃないか？
column3: Hey, isn't that Brother Liu?

column2: 李兄！どうしてあなたもここに？まさか婿選びに参加しに来たのですか！
column3: Brother Li! What are you doing here too? Don't tell me you've come to enter the contest!

column2: ここがやけににぎやかだったから、ちょっとのぞきに来ただけさ。
column3: I just saw how lively it was here and came over for a look.
